title: Three Thanksgivings and One Short Note
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情感与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情感与心理）　|　核心词汇：gratitude　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gratitude 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the nurse ① earned the gratitude that no patient in the ward would have described, and she said the earning was the whole of the Thanksgiving. The ② gratitude, meaning the feeling itself and not the present, ran three Thanksgivings and stayed undescribed in the book; gratitude, she said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of gratitude in that ward had the same short note beside it, and the ④ gratitude at the far bed, meaning the thanks they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Gratitude, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the nurse said the describing is the part that fills three Thanksgivings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gratitude was the whole of the matter, meaning the debt and not the feeling. The ⑥ gratitude, meaning the debt and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gratitude, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both a feeling and a debt. He said the debt is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ gratitude had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ gratitude of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in November, was one ward and three Thanksgivings of describing; gratitude, she said, is either the thanks at the far bed or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gratitude I remember is the gratitude described in the letter, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the ward. ⑩ Gratitude, my mother said in 1972, is the only feeling that improves by being described; all gratitude, she said, is a debt that has agreed to look like a feeling. She said the debt was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 感激；感谢（指病区里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 感激；感谢（指那份感情本身，与礼物相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the gratitude 赢得感激
D. n. 谢意（指留给孩子们学着表达的那一句）
E. n. 感恩（抽象总称，指一处病区的致谢之事）
F. n. 感激（指信里写到、被记下的那些）
G. n. 恩情；人情债（指一件事里人人都欠却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 人情（抽象总称，指人人都欠却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the gratitude that no patient in the ward would have described
The gratitude, meaning the feeling itself and not the present
Every kind of gratitude in that ward
the gratitude at the far bed
the gratitude was the whole of the matter
the gratitude had become a line in a letter
The gratitude of the whole thing

answers.why: earn the gratitude 意为“赢得感激”，1963 年那位护士赢得了病区里没有一位病人肯描述的感激。
gratitude 意为“感激、感谢”，指那份感情本身而不是礼物，它经过了三个感恩节而在簿子上没有被描述。
gratitude 意为“感激、感谢”，指病区里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有一张矮矮的便条。
gratitude 意为“谢意”，指最远那张床边留给孩子们学着表达的那一句，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gratitude 意为“恩情、人情债”，指一件事里人人都欠却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份人情就是那件事的全部。
gratitude 意为“人情”，指人人都欠却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份感激，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gratitude 意为“感激”，指信里写到、被记下的那些，到 1968 年这些成了信里的一行。
gratitude 意为“感恩”，护士十一月写道，整件事的致谢之事是一处病区和三个感恩节的描述。
gratitude 意为“感激”，我记得的是信里描述过的那些，1970 年过去了，至今仍被说成病区里最安静的一句。
gratitude 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，感激是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的感情。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年那位护士赢得了病区里没有一位病人肯描述的感激，她说赢得感激才是那个感恩节的全部。（earn the gratitude）
那份感激，指的是那份感情本身而不是礼物，经过了三个感恩节而在簿子上没有被描述。（gratitude）
那处病区里每一种感激旁边都有一张矮矮的便条。（gratitude）
最远那张床边那句谢意，指的是他们留给孩子们学着表达的那一句，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（gratitude）
叔叔说这份人情就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那份感激。（gratitude）
1972 年母亲说，感激是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的感情。（gratitude）

Every kind of gratitude in that ward had the same short note beside it.
The gratitude at the far bed, meaning the thanks they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the gratitude was the whole of the matter, meaning the debt and not the feeling.
Gratitude, my mother said in 1972, is the only feeling that improves by being described.
